_comment: Term decisions for dictionary reviews (docs/DICTIONARY.md, Terms). A term lists the Zomi words a Zomi speaker gave for an English word, so reviewers see them beside every sense that uses it. 'suggest' rewrites the Zomi mechanically into a draft for reviewers, never into the dictionary: a reviewer confirms or changes each row, then a lead editor approves it. Record only what a Zomi speaker said; a term counts as confirmed only when a second person has checked it.

refugee.note: Project owner, 2026-10-31: the better word for refugee is gambelmi. Earlier the same day: refugee is galtaimi; cimawh, dongtuak and galtaimi all mean refugee, chosen by context; cimawh is someone helpless, and dongtuak, liangvai and genthei mean the same.
